server_semantics: when saved owner account is unavailable, existingChatId is null and the replacement account must receive full local history on a fresh upstream thread

reproduction.durable_history: system owner prompt + prior user context + assistant tool_calls [call-A, call-B]
reproduction.incoming: truncated explicit transcript containing only call-A plus tool result A
reproduction.saved_owner: unavailable, so fresh sibling route is required

risk: The account/thread failover path promises a fresh sibling thread with complete local history, but restoreCheckpoint returns an explicit multi-message caller transcript unchanged. A truncated/stale transcript therefore seeds the new account with incomplete context and can hide an unresolved sibling mutating call.

candidate_contract.rule: when server is creating or rebasing onto a fresh upstream thread, provider payload must use authoritative merged checkpoint history, not merely the caller transcript
candidate_contract.same_owner_compatibility: an existing healthy owner thread may retain the incremental caller-message behavior
candidate_contract.expected_fresh_payload: stored system + prior turns + fresh incoming progress; unresolved call-B remains visible

relationship_to_previous_finding: The previous durable-obligation patch protects stored state. This separate seam protects what a fresh replacement account actually receives after account/thread failover.
limits: No hosted CI or trigger push
No production, real accounts, user data or secrets
